reason: The Indian flying fox. Pteropus giganteus was its name until Pteropus medius Temminck, 1825 was shown to be the valid one (Mlíkovský 2012); the Catalogue of Life places giganteus Brünnich, 1782 under Pteropus vampyrus, but GloBI, BOLD and the bird and mammal literature from India use it for the Indian flying fox.
GBIF keys records from India filed as Pteropus giganteus to Pteropus vampyrus, a flying fox of Southeast Asia that no Indian checklist lists; they are the Indian flying fox.
